script: Create a requisition. A requisition is the request to recruit. It's built from a position, and it copies that position the moment you submit. Vanderbilt's recruiting is outsourced to Cielo, which bills for every opening and every fill, so open only what you'll actually fill.
Check the position first. Confirm it has a six-digit job code, and the right location and category. The requisition snapshots the position at submission, and bad data flows on to the new hire.
Go to Our Workforce, then Hiring, then Job Requisitions, and select Create at the top.
Choose Standard, and select the position. Pipeline is for recruiters only. The position's job details fill in, and the position can't be changed after this.
The requisition title is the posting title. Change it to something candidates understand, for example add Senior, or Hybrid.
Choose the justification: new to the department, or replacing someone. For openings, choose Limited and the exact number of seats. Never Unlimited. Each opening is billed.
Add the hiring manager, not you, unless you are. Add collaborators who should see candidates or interview, including any HCM you work with.
For requisition type, Standard is the full recruiting process. Abbreviated means you already have a candidate, usually internal, and it must still be posted internally for five business days.
Organization is always Vanderbilt. Pick the specific location, never United States. Location tells recruiting whether pay transparency applies.
Fill in the required details: funding source, driving, replacing a RIF role, fingerprinting, motor vehicle record, and work with minors. Salary range is optional. Skip Tier; it's for billing.
Paste the position description into the description, so the recruiter can post it. They can't post from an attachment. You can write different internal and external versions.
In offer info, pick On site, Hybrid, or Remote. Skip Grades, and leave Primary work location as it is.
Attach the position description and the pre-search memo. Central recruiting checks the memo exists, is from the last twelve months, and has the same job code as the requisition.

In Configuration, New York requisitions must use the New York candidate selection process. Everything else uses Standard. The background check vendor is HireRight. The account is V A N zero zero zero for anywhere except New York, and V A N zero nine for New York.

Select Save, then Submit. Ignore the background check packages pop-up; the recruiter picks packages at the offer. Approval goes to the hiring line manager, your business unit's financial approver, then central recruiting.

Three things to remember. Never select Unlimited openings. Never use United States as the location. And for New York, use the New York candidate selection process and account V A N zero nine, every time.
